seo.title: AI Observability - Cost, Tokens and Latency for Every Model Call
seo.description: See what every AI call costs, how long it takes and which user it belongs to. Wrappers for the Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI and Anthropic, traces for agents, and prompts stored only if you want them.

hero.heading: AI observability: cost, tokens and latency for every model call
hero.subheading: Wrap the Vercel AI SDK, the OpenAI client or the Anthropic client once, or send the events yourself, and every generation shows up with its cost, tied to the user and the session behind it.

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about AI observability in OpenPanel.

items.question: Which SDKs can send AI events?
items.answer: `@openpanel/ai` wraps the Vercel AI SDK (`openpanelAiMiddleware`), the official `openai` client (`wrapOpenAI`, including Azure and any OpenAI-compatible base URL) and the Anthropic client (`wrapAnthropic`). Any other backend sends the manual `ai()` call from `@openpanel/sdk`. AI events always go through a server with the client secret.

items.question: What is stored for each call?
items.answer: Model, provider, input and output tokens, cost, latency, errors and the kind of call (generation, embedding, span or trace), linked to the profile and session. Prompts and completions are stored only when you turn on content storage in the project's AI settings, and they expire after 30 days.

items.question: How is cost calculated?
items.answer: From a built-in price catalog per model, or from the `cost` value you send with the event. Models that are not in the catalog are stored with a cost of zero until you send one.

items.question: Can I see what a single user costs me?
items.answer: Yes. AI usage shows on the profile page and the session page, and cost per user, feature and model is on the AI overview.

items.question: Does it work self-hosted?
items.answer: Yes. AI events go through the same ingest as every other event and land in your own ClickHouse.
